mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 trigger activates but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (> 0.5pp in one month) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE spike trigger activates but SPX 5-day returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by > 10% year-over-year while the 10-year Treasury yield (not in catalog) is rising, it signals a demand-driven slowdown in the housing sector that will negatively impact the broader economy and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST declines > 10% y-o-y while 10y yields are rising, but SPX 60-day returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the Consumer Price Index (> 0.5% month-over-month) combined with a flat or declining federal funds rate signals a loss of purchasing power that will erode consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp m-o-m while FEDFUNDS is flat/declining, but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Steadily declining initial jobless claims (proxied by PAYEMS) signal a tightening labor market that will boost wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS steadily declines but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales (> 1% month-over-month) signals a sudden weakening in consumer demand that will negatively impact corporate revenues and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines > 1% m-o-m but SPX 5-day returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (proxied by INDPRO) grows faster than the rate of GDP growth (proxied by GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters, it signals supply constraints that will drive inflation and negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth exceeds GDPC1 growth for 2 quarters, but SPX 60-day returns are positive > 40% of the time.
